instruction: Cinematic medium shot inside an indoor boxing ring. On the left, the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit (R1) stands facing right, holding up a red focus mitt. On the right, the woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands facing left, keeping her left arm extended with her black boxing glove pressed against the mitt of the woman in the black and orange jumpsuit. The background features dark hanging punching bags under cool, dim overhead gym lighting.

R2 extends her black boxing glove into R1's mitt
R1 is the mitt holder while R2 is the puncher
R2's glove is pressed against the mitt held by R1
